problem:
Given the statement

$$
P:3\text{ is smaller than }5
$$

 
which of the following represents $¬P?$
worked_solution:
The symbol "$¬$" represents negation. So, our task is to negate the given sentence. 

To negate our plain English sentence, we place the words "It is not true that" in front of it. This gives the following:

$$
¬P:\text{It is not true that }3\text{ is smaller than }5.
$$

 

In other words, $3$ is *not* smaller than $5.$ Therefore, $¬P$ means the following:

$$
¬P:3\text{ is }\text{not}\text{ smaller than }5.
$$

 

Note that $P$ is **true,** while $¬P$ is **false.**
